scatterplot.def: A graph of two quantitative variables measured on the same individuals: one point per individual, with the explanatory variable on the horizontal axis and the response variable on the vertical axis.

direction-form-strength.def: The features used to describe a scatterplot. Direction: positive (both rise together), negative (one rises as the other falls) or none. Form: linear or curved. Strength: how closely the points follow the form.
